data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH issued a final invoice (Schlussrechnung) for electricity at Lindenweg 12 following the move-out, covering usage from 1 January to 31 March 2026. The total invoice amount is €105.58, due within 30 days of the invoice date (14 April 2026).
data.explanation: This is your final electricity settlement (Schlussrechnung) after moving out of Lindenweg 12, covering the period from 1 January to 31 March 2026 including extra usage of 212 kWh. The total owed is €105.58. Pay it by the deadline shown, quoting the invoice number as reference if your bank asks. If the amount doesn't match your own meter readings or you already paid a final deposit, contact Stadtwerke Musterstadt's customer service to clarify before paying. If left unpaid, the provider may send reminders and could eventually pursue debt collection.
